title: Clear worker record range
summary: Walk 24-byte records, decrement the adjusted owner's 32-bit reference count and invoke its first virtual entry with 1 when the count reaches zero; reset the range end to its current beginning.
test_description: Compare the implementation and original on empty and six-record ranges containing null pointers, shared owners, zero and positive reference counts, and a callback changing the range. Verify callback order, arguments, counts, the cached end, reset range, and untouched payload and object fields.
known_limits: Names and broader semantics of the referenced objects and virtual method are unresolved.
Requires valid 32-bit game layouts and a reachable end at a 24-byte stride; malformed ranges and exceptional callbacks are not tested.
No claim of matching machine code or native 64-bit layout.
